sources.quote: All requests use the base URL
sources.facts: HTTPS adsapi.snapchat.com/v1; Bearer header. Organization-admin-created OAuth app required.
Authorization-code flow and refresh endpoint; snapchat-marketing-api permits reads/writes; snapchat-offline-conversions-api is separate. Protect client secrets; Organization Admin creates apps.
FAQ specifies SSL redirects and no fixed refresh-token expiry; access removal can invalidate refresh. No loopback exception found: paste-token only.
organizations[].organization contains id/name; top-level and per-entity success. No organization-list pagination support located.
GET /organizations/{id}/adaccounts; adaccounts[].adaccount id/name/organization_id/status/currency/timezone. Selected organization must match.
GET /adaccounts/{id}/campaigns; GET /campaigns/{id}. campaigns[].campaign id/name/ad_account_id/status/start_time/end_time. Private ownership GET precedes campaign stats.
GET /adaccounts/{id}/creatives; creatives[].creative id/name/ad_account_id/type/review_status. Existing creatives only; no uploads.
Account/campaign/creative pages support limit and paging.next_link cursor; rebuild fixed URLs. SUCCESS and success appear in official examples; both supported.

sources.quote: spend metric is the only metric available
sources.facts: GET /adaccounts/{id}/stats account spend only; /campaigns/{id}/stats spend/impressions/swipes. R1 TOTAL + explicit ISO start_time/end_time at account-day boundaries. total_stats[].total_stat id/type/granularity/stats; optional provider windows and finalized_data_end_time/conversion_data_processed_end_time retained. No half-open-boundary guarantee found.
Money is micro-units of account currency. Preserve decimal integer strings; reject unsafe JSON numbers.
Average 20 requests/s/app and 10/token; excess returns 429. R1 exposes typed limit_exceeded, no automatic retry or limiter.
Historical deprecation statement only; no current universal sunset promise asserted.
Official SDK search located CAPI clients, not a usable TypeScript Marketing API client/spec. No dependency added. R2 must independently verify CAPI v3 mapping.
